subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should hook installation intentionally require `HOOK.md` to be a regular, non-symlink file no larger than 1 MiB?
rationale: The patch fixes unbounded allocation but also narrows accepted file forms through the selected dependency, so the security-versus-compatibility boundary requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Approve strict hook metadata
options.body: Require regular, non-symlink `HOOK.md` files within the 1 MiB limit and proceed after refreshing the branch.

options.title: Limit allocation only
options.body: Use a different bounded reader if symlinked or non-regular metadata is an intended supported install contract.

recommendation.title: Approve strict hook metadata
recommendation.body: Require regular, non-symlink `HOOK.md` files within the 1 MiB limit and proceed after refreshing the branch.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the affected install flow and is explicitly assigned to the live PR.
